senses.gloss: m. (contr. of אַפְעָא q. v.) a striped wild animal (of the genus felis) of which the male (stronger) and the female species are distinguished, corresp. to h. צָבוּע q. v.; leopard, and hyæna striata (striped hyena).
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 16a:19">B. Kam. 16ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="N01081"><he>נפרזא</he></cite> leopard); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 16a:19">ib.</cite> (expl. <cite ref="R00025"><he>צבוע</he></cite>); v. discussion <cite ref="Bava Kamma 16a:19">ib.</cite>
Yoma 84ᵃ א׳ דיכרא Ms. M. (ed. דדיכרא, corr. acc.) a male afa. [Not to be confounded with b. h. אֶפְעֶה, v. Nöld. M. Gr. p. 58 sq. note.]
